title: Graduate Software Engineer — Platform & Infrastructure
description:
OVHcloud is Europe's leading cloud provider, managing millions of servers across global datacentres. We handle everything from server hardware design to cloud platform development, with a strong focus on open source and European sovereignty.

About the Role:
You will join our Platform Infrastructure team working on low-latency systems, Linux infrastructure and distributed systems at scale. You will contribute to building and optimizing the software layer powering OVHcloud's datacentres.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement infrastructure software in Go and Rust
- Work on low-latency networking and platform engineering
- Contribute to Linux systems optimization and monitoring
- Automate infrastructure management and deployment pipelines
- Collaborate with hardware and network teams

Requirements:
- Strong Linux knowledge — kernel, system programming, drivers
- Experience with C, Rust or Go
- Low-level systems programming background
- Understanding of networking and distributed systems
- Python or Bash scripting

Nice to Have:
- Kernel driver development
- Container runtimes and virtualization
- Performance profiling tools (perf, strace, valgrind)
- Experience with storage systems

Tech Stack:
Go, Rust, Linux, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana
